name: Bạch Đăng Tùng
bio: Bạch Đăng Tùng is a Naarm-based filmmaker and writer from Hanoi, Vietnam.

credits.title: Mirror of the Evening
credits.overview: In the middle of the night in Hanoi, a grieving young man reunites with his estranged twin brother, who returns with stories from Australia. Meanwhile, their mother struggles to sleep as a train runs past her bedroom.

credits.title: Rain Falls Still
credits.overview: A Buddhist temple prepares for the Vu Lan festival. Wearing a white rose on his chest, a young monk cooks a meal of offering as dreams of a rainy day wash over him.

credits.title: Tongues of Fire
credits.overview: Against the background of a holiday season, houses begin to burn down.

credits.title: On The Birthday of The Wind
credits.overview: In the gentle breezes of spring, death emerges. A sun-wrapped suburban home listens to a conversation between Ringo, a film student, and Daisy, a dying cat who understands Vietnamese.
